create.name: Sasha Graham
create.bio:
Sasha Graham is a tarot author, deck creator and teacher whose work centres on reading the cards intuitively and using them for reflection, ritual and storytelling. She has written a dozen books for Llewellyn and other publishers, among them 365 Tarot Spreads, 365 Tarot Spells and The Magic of Tarot, which received a COVR Visionary Award, and her books have been translated into more than ten languages. She has also edited and written for Lo Scarabeo's tarot series and contributes regularly to Llewellyn's almanacs and calendars. Her decks, made with illustrators such as Abigail Larson and Mirco Pierfederici, include The Vampire's Tale Tarot, Tarot of the Haunted House, Dark Wood Tarot and Tarot of the Witch's Garden.

Graham teaches classes on subjects such as the court cards and the Rider-Waite-Smith imagery, online and in person, and at Kripalu she co-leads a weekend with yoga teacher Alison DeNicola that brings tarot archetypes into movement, meditation and journaling. Her approach has a gothic, playful edge that reflects her other life as an actor and storyteller: she hosts a monthly live ghost-story evening and podcast, and wrote and performed a one-woman show on ghosts and tarot at the 2026 Edinburgh Festival Fringe. Her YouTube channel includes card-by-card video guides to her decks.

books.title: The Magic of Tarot: Your Guide to Intuitive Readings, Rituals, and Spells
books.author: Sasha Graham
books.description: A guide to reading tarot from intuition rather than memorised meanings, with card-by-card notes, readings and simple rituals and spells built around the cards. It won a COVR Visionary Award for best tarot book.

books.title: 365 Tarot Spreads: Revealing the Magic in Each Day
books.author: Sasha Graham
books.description: A spread for every day of the year, each tied to a date, festival or theme. It is designed as a year-long reading practice for beginners and experienced readers alike.

books.title: 365 Tarot Spells: Creating the Magic in Each Day
books.author: Sasha Graham
books.description: A companion to her book of spreads, with a short card-based ritual for each day of the year. The spells use tarot images as a focus for intention and reflection.

books.title: Dark Wood Tarot
books.author: Sasha Graham
books.description: A 78-card deck and guidebook illustrated by Abigail Larson, set in a shadowy forest and built around a journey through the darker parts of the psyche.

books.title: Tarot of the Witch's Garden
books.author: Sasha Graham
books.description: A deck and guidebook illustrated by Natasa Ilincic that links each card to plants, flowers and garden lore. It won a COVR award for best tarot deck in 2023.

books.title: Tarot of the Haunted House
books.author: Sasha Graham
books.description: A gothic deck illustrated by Mirco Pierfederici in which each suit is a room of an old house and the reader walks through it card by card. Her YouTube video guidebook accompanies it.

books.title: The Vampire's Tale Tarot
books.author: Sasha Graham
books.description: Her newest deck, again illustrated by Abigail Larson, following a vampire heroine through the 78 cards as a story of death and rebirth.

courses.title: Awaken Your Inner Magic: A Yoga and Tarot Weekend
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, co-led with yoga teacher Alison DeNicola. Using the Rider Waite deck, participants explore tarot archetypes and suits through yoga, guided meditation, visualisation and journaling, and practise short readings with each other.

courses.title: Tarot's Royal Archetypes: Court Cards in Context
courses.description: A two-hour online class on Zoom about the sixteen court cards, looking at Pages, Knights, Queens and Kings as types of personality and behaviour. It includes guided meditation, writing prompts and practice readings.

free_resources.title: Tarot of the Haunted House: video guidebook series
free_resources.description: A free six-part video series on her YouTube channel walking through her Tarot of the Haunted House deck, from the major arcana through each minor suit.
